summary: Tested iteration 194 features: TeamActivityToast solo user fix, custom exercise creation, exercise detail page with edit params/weight, weight chart, workout timer. All backend APIs (8/8) and frontend features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing user with active solo program and assigned exercise Squat
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 194 features verified. User Josette has active solo program (team=null) and assigned exercise Squat (id=e2c5bcdd-b6c0-4ff6-8586-41b9460d7702) with equipment Barre and weight_history. TeamActivityToast correctly skips polling for solo users. Exercise detail page has edit params (+/- buttons), edit weight (with OK button), weight chart SVG, workout timer with rest countdown, and validation section.

team_activity_toast_solo_fix.details: GET /api/programs/active returns team=null for solo users. TeamActivityToast.tsx checks for team before polling feed (line 30). No toast appears for solo users.

custom_exercise_creation.details: POST /api/pro/self-assign-exercise with exercise_template_id='__custom__' creates custom exercise with title, sets, reps, rest_seconds. Backend lines 2072-2095 handle custom creation.

create_self_page.details: Frontend /pro-exercise-detail?mode=create-self shows form with title, description, muscle_group, equipment, series, reps, repos inputs and 'Creer et ajouter' button.

exercise_detail_edit_params.details: Edit params button (pencil icon) visible. Clicking shows StatEditor with +/- buttons for Series, Reps, Repos. Save/Cancel buttons work correctly.

exercise_detail_edit_weight.details: Edit weight button (pencil icon) visible. Clicking shows weight input field with OK button. Weight saves correctly via PUT /api/pro/assigned-exercises/{id}/save-weight.

exercise_detail_header.details: Header shows only title 'Squat', no icon. Clean design as requested.

weight_chart.details: Weight chart SVG visible when weight_history > 1. Shows 'Evolution du poids' with line graph and clickable points.

workout_timer.details: 'Commencer l'exercice' button visible. Clicking shows series counter (Serie 1/9) and 'Serie terminee' button. After completing set, rest timer shows countdown with 'Passer le repos' option.

responsive_design.details: Content stays within 480px max width. Tested on mobile viewport (390px). All elements properly sized and readable.

validation_section.details: Validation section visible with pain level (1-10 scale) and notes input. Valider button works correctly.

TeamActivityToast_tsx_line_30.details: Correctly checks for team before polling: if (!activeRes?.team || !activeRes.active) { setHasFeed(false); return; }

professional_routes_lines_2072-2095.details: Custom exercise creation with __custom__ template_id correctly creates exercise with user-provided title, sets, reps, rest_seconds

pro-exercise-detail_tsx.details: Full rewrite with create-self form (lines 135-158), StatEditor component (lines 366-377), WeightChart component (lines 379-428), workout timer (lines 286-326)
